evidence.contextAndScope: Bootloader Internals 11편의 DHCP/BOOTP metadata, TFTP transfer, PXE/extlinux subset, U-Boot network environment variables 및 NFS-root relationship을 검토했다.
evidence.problemSignalAndCounterevidence: 기존 transcript의 10995712 decimal과 `a7c000` hex가 서로 다르고, `1500-28=1468` 산술이 틀렸다. TFTP counter heading은 32-bit라고 하면서 본문은 RFC1350 16-bit라고 했다. Option66을 next-server와 동일시하고 U-Boot가 모든 응답에서 자동 TFTP하는 절대 설명도 있었으며, `pxe` support를 PXELINUX와 동일시했다.
evidence.causeHypothesisAndAlternatives: 가공되었거나 검증되지 않은 console output과 DHCP/BOOTP field, TFTP header, PXELINUX behavior의 개념 혼합이 원인으로 보인다. 숫자 결과는 제거하고 protocol fields와 U-Boot subset을 primary sources로 구분했다.
evidence.evidence: Local arithmetic verified `10995712.toString(16)=a7c800`, IPv4 MTU 1500 minus IP 20, UDP 8, TFTP DATA header 4 equals 1468 data bytes. RFC1350 specifies 512-byte lockstep blocks; RFC2348 negotiates data block size excluding the four-byte TFTP header; RFC7440 defines windowsize. RFC2131 defines `siaddr` as next bootstrap server, while RFC2132 options 66/67 identify TFTP server name/bootfile under specified overloaded-field conditions. U-Boot PXE docs state RFC5071 PXELINUX DHCP option codes are unsupported. https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1350 ; https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2348 ; https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7440 ; https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2131 ; https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2132 ; https://docs.u-boot.org/en/stable/usage/pxe.html
evidence.sampleCoverage: Fake DHCP/TFTP throughput transcripts, server configs with broad permissions, PXE lookup claims beyond docs, unsupported timeout/option behavior, and repeated NFS examples were removed or narrowed. Command forms remain syntax-only. No U-Boot target or DHCP/TFTP server was available, so no positive/negative network execution occurred.
evidence.decision: Corrected the named arithmetic and protocol distinction, qualified command behavior by version/configuration, and retained RFC-supported concepts. Metadata was preserved; no title or description correction was needed.
evidence.smallestSafeChange: Edited chapter11 only; no server, boot device, network, storage or firmware was touched. Existing slug/date/draft/seriesOrder and related internal URLs were preserved.

evidence.evidence: Local arithmetic verified `0x1d59000 * 512 / 2^30 = 14.673828125 GiB` while claimed partition sizes sum to approximately 14.856 GiB.
